# CloudNuro.ai

> CloudNuro.ai is an intelligent SaaS and multi-cloud management platform enabling IT, Finance, and Security teams to optimize costs, discover shadow IT, and ensure compliance across enterprise environments.

CloudNuro provides unified visibility and governance across SaaS applications and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, OCI) with AI-powered cost optimization, FinOps services, and industry recognition including Gartner Magic Quadrant 2025 honors. The platform serves enterprises and government agencies with discovery, optimization, compliance automation, and financial accountability features.

## Key Topics

- SaaS Management
- FinOps
- Cloud Cost Optimization
- Shadow IT Detection
- License Optimization
- Multi-Cloud Governance
- AI Cost Optimization
- SaaS Discovery
- Compliance Automation
- IT Asset Management
- Cloud Custodian
- AWS/Azure/Google Cloud
- Microsoft 365 (M365)
- ServiceNow
- Salesforce
